lines.text: Why is pizza better after soccer?
Pizza hits different after a long soccer game.

data.define: Used when something feels better or more emotional than usual.

example.ctx: Eating with friends after a game
example.text: Pizza hits different after a long soccer game.

misuse.text: Don't say 'hits different' in a school essay.

hook.text: Why is pizza better after soccer?

publish.title: What does "hits different" mean?
publish.value: Hits different = It feels extra special. Example: "Pizza hits different after a long soccer game." (very casual English, US).
